correctness.rationale: The four-pebble game forgets one position and retains <=3 atomic anchors. For <=3 stationary points, equality and ternary collinearity extension types depend only on whether line size is 2,3,>=4. Three noncollinear anchors leave q^2-3q+3 off-pair-line points in affine and (q-1)^2 in projective planes, both positive for every q>=2. Permanent matching one-step extension proves unrestricted-depth FO^4 equivalence; 3- and 4-distinct-collinear sentences separate classes and 5-variable existence of two disjoint pair-lines separates affine/projective. Works for non-Desarguesian existing planes, not assumed every numerical order. Proof is general, finite prime-field examples are only corroboration.
